snippet.title: Bodycam Has Completely Changed | Animation & Loadout Devlog [1/4]
snippet.description:
The video dropped 24 hours early on IGN's YouTube channel. 
https://youtu.be/MDjn7dsnpgI?si=BGAGxrj8ep1MbzBE

Today we're releasing the 4K version on our YouTube channel.

Thank you so much for all the feedback We're so thrilled that the wait was worth it and that we can finally share everything we've been working on!

Keep in mind that this is just the first part of the update. There are three more videos coming to our own YouTube channel that will reveal other parts of the update as well!

🎮 Play Bodycam on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406770/Bodycam/



If you want to have a chance to see your clip on our networks, share it on the networks using #bodycam or #bodycamgame 🔥
